question: In a certain code language, 'WEIGHS' is coded as 'QHEICW'. What is the code for 'ABUSES' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'WEIGHS' is coded as 'QHEICW',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8960e93fd1a147d9e2d3bc7aba1584fcf06eabbc82539469fc332c2f8c78af83.png] 

Similarly, for 'ABUSES'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4714b571ff1f7d82713e44ca54b80f3beb315d9c1851a1406672b5833d309ae5.png] 

So, 'ABUSES' is coded as 'QEQUZA'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
